what: Close-reason hygiene on the paper books. MEASURED 2026-09-30 ~05:20Z via GET /api/bot/trades/closed?since=2026-09-23&include_paper=true, closeReason counts: bybit_1 119 trades = other 75 / sl 29 / tp 9 / reconciler 6; alpaca_paper 6 = other 5 / sl 1; alpaca_portfolio 5 = other 4 / sl 1. Real-money bybit_2 8/8 sl, bybit_portfolio 8/8 sl, alpaca_live 2/2 sl. Two problems. (1) The 6 bybit_1 'reconciler' closes are non-TP/SL/strategy closes, a bug class per the session contract: root-cause each (which trades, why the reconciler closed them, orphan or missed fill?). (2) 'other' is a COLLAPSED state. src/web/api/routers/trades_closed.py::_normalise_close_reason maps every exit_reason outside {tp, sl, manual, reconciler*} to 'other', so a legitimate strategy close (time stop, trail, pairs exit) and an unexplained close are indistinguishable on the wire; 75 of 119 bybit_1 closes are unreadable (see also PI-20260927-YZRZQ725-0004, the pairs-leg classification). Fix: expose the raw exit_reason beside closeReason (additive field), and break down the 'other' population by raw exit_reason; any raw reason that is not a declared strategy exit is a bug to root-cause.
